stratagems.name: Command Re-roll
stratagems.when: After you make an Advance, Charge, Hazardous or Desperate Escape test, or a Hit roll, Wound roll, Damage roll, saving throw or roll to determine the number of attacks, for a model in your army.

stratagems.name: Counter-offensive
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has fought.
stratagems.target: One unit from your army within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units that has not been selected to fight this phase.

stratagems.name: Epic Challenge
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a Character unit from your army is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: One Character model in that unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, one melee weapon equipped by that model has the [PRECISION] ability.

stratagems.name: Fire Overwatch
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement or Charge phase, just after an enemy unit is set up or starts/ends a move.
stratagems.target: One eligible unit from your army (not within Engagement Range).
stratagems.effect: Your unit shoots that enemy as if it were your Shooting phase, but only unmodified Hit rolls of 6 score a hit.

stratagems.name: Go to Ground
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Infantry unit from your army selected as a target.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Benefit of Cover and a 6+ invulnerable save.

stratagems.name: Grenade
stratagems.target: One Infantry unit with grenades, not within Engagement Range and not yet selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within 8" of and visible to your unit and roll six D6: for each 4+, it suffers 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: Heroic Intervention
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move.
stratagems.target: One unit from your army eligible to declare a charge against that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit declares a charge targeting only that enemy unit; resolve it as if it were your Charge phase.

stratagems.name: Insane Bravery
stratagems.when: The Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just before taking a Battle-shock test.
stratagems.effect: That Battle-shock test is automatically passed.

stratagems.name: Rapid Ingress
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One unit from your army in Reserves.
stratagems.effect: Set up that unit as if it were the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
stratagems.restrictions: Cannot be used to arrive turn 1.

stratagems.name: Smokescreen
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One unit from your army with the Smoke keyword selected as a target.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Benefit of Cover and the Stealth ability.

stratagems.name: Tank Shock
stratagems.target: One Vehicle unit from your army that ended a Charge move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select an enemy unit within Engagement Range and one of your weapons; roll D6s equal to that weapon's Strength (max 6): for each 5+, that enemy suffers 1 mortal wound.
